title: Result Details

fields.label: Amount
fields.name: amount
fields.instructions: The large figure, e.g. "$11B+" or "198K+". Keep it short — it renders at 32px.

fields.label: Description
fields.name: result_description
fields.instructions: One line explaining the figure. Include an as-of date where the number will age, e.g. "Across 158 active multidistrict litigations as of Q1 2026".
fields.placeholder: Total settlements secured industry-wide for cancer victims

description: Verdict and settlement figures. The post title is the case name. These are attorney advertising claims — every figure must be defensible and carry an as-of date where it will age.
